Root cause measured, not guessed: Orca Web keeps its theme in browser localStorage (orca.web.settings.v1), and the web client's settings merge never reads settings.theme, so the orca-data.json seed only steers the desktop client. Screenshots viewed by the orchestrator: theme-1-asis.png renders light, theme-2-dark.png renders dark.
